_about: Data for Assets/Scripts/WeaponGrip.cs: re-poses WeaponSocket_R relative to the hand bone every LateUpdate (absolute). socketOffset = metres in the hand-bone frame; socketEuler = degrees on the socket's original rotation; slide = metres the hand moves along the shaft towards the head. Pitborn x35 / z-120: head forward at the light impact, up and forward at the heavy impact; GripPose (absolute curl) wraps the fingers. Dracula z20 + offset + slide 0.05 seats the hilt in the fist.
